requirementsVi: Hai chủ đề nhỏ, mỗi chủ đề 3 câu hỏi.
Mỗi câu: trả lời trực tiếp → lý do → một chi tiết hoặc ví dụ.
Đọc rồi thay chi tiết cho đúng trải nghiệm của bạn.
samples.summaryVi: Thói quen tiết kiệm nước cần đi cùng cách báo và sửa rò rỉ rõ trách nhiệm.

sections.label: Tiết kiệm nước

questions.question: Are you interested in saving water in daily life?
questions.answer: Yes, I am, mainly because people can avoid wasting treated water. I would like to understand how this works in everyday life, rather than just read a definition.
questions.noteVi: Trả lời trực tiếp → thêm một lý do.

questions.question: How could you learn more about saving water in daily life?
questions.answer: I could join a community water-saving session. There, I would have a chance to identify common sources of waste and practise reporting leaks. Trying something with other people usually helps me remember it.
questions.noteVi: Nêu một cách tìm hiểu và hoạt động cụ thể.

questions.question: Is there anything difficult about saving water in daily life?
questions.answer: One possible difficulty is that simple advice may overlook problems beyond a resident's control. For example, a tenant may report a leak repeatedly but be unable to access the damaged pipe. I think it is better to recognise that problem early.
questions.noteVi: Một khó khăn → một ví dụ, không liệt kê quá nhiều.

sections.label: Kế hoạch cuối tuần & học cùng bạn bè

questions.question: What would you like to do with a friend this weekend?
questions.answer: I would like to identify common sources of waste and practise reporting leaks. We could bring a note of any water problems at home and compare what we learn. It would give us something useful to talk about afterwards.
questions.noteVi: Nêu kế hoạch, đồ cần mang và lợi ích.

questions.question: Do you prefer learning something alone or with friends?
questions.answer: For a new topic, I prefer being with one or two friends. For instance, if we were learning about saving water in daily life, we could ask each other questions. However, I like reviewing my notes alone afterwards.
questions.noteVi: Chọn một phía, thêm tình huống và một ngoại lệ.

questions.question: How do you decide whether an activity is worth your time?
questions.answer: I ask whether I can use what I learn. In this case, it would be helpful to know how to give residents an easy way to report leaks and explain who should respond. I also check the time and cost before making a plan.
questions.noteVi: Một tiêu chí → áp dụng vào tình huống → chi tiết thêm.
